latest_cos_commentary.headline: XPR POS is a self-ordering overlay (kiosk, mobile/QR, linebusting) that plugs into 15+ existing restaurant POS platforms rather than replacing them, with named customers including Burger King, Dunkin', Delaware North, and Aramark.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Directly relevant: XPR's own marketing lists "Genius POS (Heartland)" as one of its supported integrations, positioning XPR as a complementary ordering layer on top of Genius rather than a rip-and-replace competitor — though this vendor claim has not been independently confirmed.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Actively marketing enterprise foodservice/travel-concession wins (airports, national parks) as a growth channel distinct from traditional QSR chains.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Confirm whether a Genius customer considering XPR is looking to add a self-order overlay (complementary) versus evaluating XPR as a POS replacement, since these are different competitive conversations.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: The claimed Genius POS/Heartland integration is stated only on XPR's own site and has not been independently verified; performance and average-check-lift figures are vendor-reported.

verification_needed: Independent confirmation of the claimed Genius POS (Heartland) integration
